question: In May 2025, in which state did the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully conduct the maiden flight-trial of its Stratospheric Airship Platform?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** achieved a significant technological milestone in **May 2025** by successfully conducting the maiden flight-trial of its **Stratospheric Airship Platform (SAP)**.
 
• The flight-trial was conducted in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**, which provided the necessary geographical and logistical support for high-altitude aeronautical testing. ***Hence, the statement regarding the location is correct.***
 
• The **Stratospheric Airship Platform** is designed to operate in the **stratosphere** at altitudes ranging from **18 to 22 kilometers**, placing it well above the range of conventional weather systems and commercial air traffic.
